title: Equipment Refined
description: Gives gold and copper tools a reason to be used. Also allows for neat upgrades on netherite tools and armor.
body:
# Description
This pack slightly alters the vanilla progression by changing the following.

1. Replaces all wooden tools with a singular multitool.
2. Copper tools can no longer be enchanted with fortune but give a similar effect without any enchantment.
3. Gold tools have greatly increased durability and the mining level is nearly on par with iron - only diamond and emerald ores can't be mined with it.
4. Netherite now has built-in autosmelt: ores -> ingots, meat -> cooked meat
5. Netherite tools can now be upgraded inside the smithing table with an echo shard giving them magnetism.
6. Netherite armor can now be upgraded inside the smithing table with an ender pearl and a chorus flower giving each armor piece a unique effect.


# Notes
This pack changes some loot tables of blocks (everything effected by fortune), chests (containing gold tools) and entities (mainly meat dropping entities). Thus it will be incompatible with packs changing the same loot tables.
